description: This file contains JavaScript code for client-side functionality in the OFBiz framework. It provides utilities for AJAX operations, DOM manipulation, event handling, UI enhancements such as autocompletes, in-place editing, and pop-up management. The code is part of a common theme, intended to be included across multiple pages to facilitate dynamic interactions and asynchronous updates.

methods.name: ajaxUpdateArea
methods.description: Updates a specific HTML area with content fetched from a given URL and parameters, optionally showing a spinner.

methods.name: ajaxUpdateAreas
methods.description: Performs multiple area updates based on a CSV string specifying area IDs, target URLs, and parameters.

methods.name: ajaxUpdateAreaPeriodic
methods.description: Periodically updates a specified area by repeatedly fetching fresh content at set intervals.

methods.name: ajaxSubmitRequestUpdateAreas
methods.description: Submits an AJAX POST request and upon success, updates multiple designated areas.

methods.name: submitFormInBackground
methods.description: Submits a form via AJAX and loads the response into a specified area without reloading the page.

methods.name: containsErrorMessages
methods.description: Checks if data contains error message indicators.

methods.name: displayErrorMessages
methods.description: Displays error messages within the page UI.

methods.name: containsEventMessage
methods.description: Checks if data includes event message indicators.

methods.name: displayEventMessage
methods.description: Displays event messages within the page UI.

methods.name: clearErrorMessages
methods.description: Removes error message display elements from the page.

methods.name: errorRetrievingResponseFromServer
methods.description: Handles AJAX error scenarios, displaying a message if server response is unavailable.

methods.name: ajaxSubmitFormUpdateAreas
methods.description: Submits a form via AJAX and updates page areas based on the server response.

methods.name: ajaxAutoCompleter
methods.description: Enables AJAX-powered autocomplete functionality on input fields, with optional descriptions.

methods.name: setUserLayoutPreferences
methods.description: Sends user interface preferences to the server for persistence.

methods.name: showErrorAlert
methods.description: Displays a modal alert dialog with an error message.

methods.name: submitPagination
methods.description: Handles pagination link clicks or selections, possibly using AJAX.

methods.name: loadJWT
methods.description: Synchronously loads a JWT token from the server.

methods.name: sendJWT
methods.description: Sends a request with a JWT token for authentication.

methods.name: importLibrary
methods.description: Loads external JavaScript or CSS files asynchronously with callbacks.

methods.name: replaceQueryParam
methods.description: Replaces or adds query parameters in URLs.

methods.name: waitSpinnerShow
methods.description: Displays a loading spinner centered on the screen.

methods.name: waitSpinnerHide
methods.description: Hides the loading spinner.

methods.name: getJSONuiLabels
methods.description: Fetches UI label strings from server for localization.

methods.name: getJSONuiLabel
methods.description: Fetches a specific UI label string.

methods.name: importLibrary
methods.description: Loads external JavaScript or CSS files asynchronously with callbacks, handling duplicates with caching, and adjusting relative paths in CSS files.

methods.name: isLocalEnviron
methods.description: Checks if the browser is accessing from a local environment (localhost or 127.0.0.1).
